data.name: Abal
data.gender_notes: Abal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abal is the Arabic name for 'Father of the Wolf'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Abal', which means 'father'. The name also carries the theme of strength and power, as wolves are known for their fierce and protective nature. The name Abal carries the meaning “Father of the Wolf” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abal usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the wolf and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abal is a name that signifies protection and leadership, reflecting the nurturing and caring qualities of a father. It is a powerful name that embodies the strength and courage of a wolf, making it an excellent choice for parents looking for a name that inspires a sense of strength and resilience in their child.
data.etymology: Abal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of the Wolf.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: ابال

in_hindi.name: अबाल

in_english.name: Abal
in_english.meaning: Abal means a person who elevates or does good
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abal is derived from the Arabic root 'أ ب ل' (ʾ-b-l), which means to elevate or to do good. This name is often used to describe someone who holds a high position or rank in society. Derivatives of the root are found in the Quran in various contexts, lending the name religious and spiritual significance. Historically, the name has been used across Islamic traditions to signify individuals of good character and high moral standards. The name Abal conveys a sense of nobility and positive action.
